# Dr Hardman

> Fresh, natural skin and hair care handmade in Finland by Dr Lotta Hardman (PhD in genetics and population biology). No preservatives, no emulsifiers, no aluminium – raw shea butter, cocoa butter, oils, aloe vera and clay. Slogan: "Clean food for healthy skin". The site is in Swedish (main) and Finnish (/fi/).

Orders by email: {{ site.email }}. Prices are listed on each product page.
